responseMessageContents.text:
Your screenshot is the **Supabase project API keys page** — not the **Management API token** page. Those are two different tokens.

- **Publishable key** (`sb_publish...`) — goes in the Expo app / frontend (anon key).
- **Secret key** (`sb_secret_Rxi...`) — goes in the backend (service role key).
- **Management API token** (`sbp_...`) — what was revoked (`sbp_f5ad980bd19f4edd...`), used only for `api.supabase.com` operations.

The **service role key** and **anon key** are fine. The **Management API token** (`sbp_...`) is what died.

If you want to generate a fresh Management API token, go to **https://supabase.com/dashboard/account/tokens** (not the project API keys page). That's the one IVX needs if you want schema migrations enabled again. But as I said, it's optional now — DB operations work through the service role key.
